memoryBuilder.verseText: God heard His people crying. God remembered His promise.

sequence.prompt: How did God keep baby Moses safe? Put it in order.

items.label: A new king made God's people slaves
God's people cried out, and God heard
His mother hid him in a reed basket
The princess found him and loved him

matches.prompt: Match each one to what they did.

pairs.right: Made a basket and hid her baby

application.question: God hears people when they cry. Who do you know that needs help right now?
application.followUp: God heard His people for four hundred years, and He never forgot one word of His promise. He hears you, and He hears the person you just thought of.
